scope: Bounded additive cell-type-annotation-transfer intake (issue #349), independently reviewed by Codex before this ingestion (docs/omics/evidence-research/cell-type-completion-assessment-2026-10-07.md). Ingests Abdelaal et al. 2019 Figure S10 Panel B (34-population inter-dataset brain comparison), SVMrejection row only: nine percent-unlabeled values across all nine VISp/ALM/MTG train-test combinations, read directly from a page-image render of the supplement PDF (not pdftotext, not OCR, not color inference) and independently cross-checked by a separate reviewer before ingestion. Reuses the existing SVMrejection method/configuration records unmodified. Adds one new source record for the supplement PDF (a separate byte artifact, SHA-256 797a2b22f584135f4ff6f7c98203d8e9529d6600f675b500205607b47b212a81, from the already-catalogued main-text XML), three new dataset records (VISp, ALM, MTG; Table 2 raw totals recorded as context only, not a scored denominator), one new protocol record, nine new evaluation records and nine new result records. See research.md for the full scope, exclusions and rationale.
required_interpretation_limits: Automated source review; no human scientific review or new model execution.

Scored denominator is unreported in the retrieved main text and supplement; Table 2's raw per-dataset cell counts (VISp 12,832; ALM 8,758; MTG 14,636) are context only on the linked dataset records, not a confirmed denominator, and must not be used to back-calculate rejected-cell counts.
metric_direction is "unknown" for every result: percentage unlabeled is a coverage/rejection-rate figure, not a standalone performance metric with one universal direction.
Not a known-type accuracy claim, not an unknown/absent-type-detection accuracy claim, and not a superiority claim over any other classifier; no comparison across methods is asserted.
Only the SVMrejection row is ingested; the other 17 classifiers in the same Figure S10 Panel B heatmap, and the entire Figure S10 Panel A (3-population level), remain unextracted.
Figure S9 Panel A carries no printed digit labels at any resolution checked and separately shows an unresolved conflict between its caption, legend and title text; nothing from Figure S9 is ingested.
Reference labels are the original brain-atlas studies' author annotations, not independently adjudicated ground truth.
This pass adds one new active mapping for use-case-cell-type-annotation-transfer; the four existing active mappings for this use case are unchanged.

Predates scTab, CellTypist, Azimuth, scANVI and scParadise; does not evaluate them, and does not measure or substitute for the common-protocol cross-study benchmark gap tracked separately at rewire-benchmarks #27.
